newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - U.S. Robotics shares rise.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - U.S. Robotics shares rise.

text.p: Shares in U.S. Robotics Corp moved higher in busy after-hours activity, following the release of the company's fourth-quarter earnings, traders said.
The shares were moving as high as 61, up 1-1/2 from its close of 59-1/2.

The company, based in Skokie, Ill., posted fourth-quarter earnings of $0.14 per share, including an acquisition charge. Without the charge, the quarterly earnings were $0.71 per share compared to $0.37 per share the same period last year.
The company also said it expected demand for all its product lines to grow substantially in fiscal year 1997, with network system sales growing faster than PC-related sales.

The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 18,400 shares compared with 490,600 shares on Friday. Session two volume was 7,683,800 shares compared with Friday's volume of 1,235,700 shares.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
